violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED COMMERCIALLY VACUUM PACKAGED SALMON IN THE THREE-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER IN INTACT PACKAGING.
violations.corrective_action: PIC OPENED THE PACKAGING DURING INSPECTION. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE AND PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THE SALMON SHOULD BE REMOVED FROM THE PACKAGING/THE PACKAGING SHOULD BE SLIT OPEN WHEN THE FISH IS PULLED TO THAW. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION. UPTOWN CAFE DULLES (Inspection Date: 07/15/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Hood, Adequate
violations.observation: OBSERVED TWO INDUCTION PLATES AND AN ELECTRIC SKILLET. PIC INFORMED EHS THAT THEY ARE USED TO REHEAT FOODS FOR IMMEDIATE SERVICE OR TO COOK VEGETABLES (WITH OIL). EHS CONFIRMED INDUCTION PLATES ARE ETL SANITATION APPROVED.
violations.corrective_action: Ventilation hood systems and devices shall operate properly and be sufficient in number and capacity to prevent grease or condensation from collecting on walls and ceilings. PIC HAS AGREED TO DISCONTINUE USING EQUIPMENT FOR THE TIME BEING AND UNDERSTANDS NO FOOD ITEMS CAN BE COOKED HERE WITHOUT A HOOD SYSTEM. PLEASE CONTACT THE ADMINISTRATIVE TEAM ([county email]) TO DISCUSS WITH THE PLAN REVIEW TEAM REQUIREMENTS FOR USING THIS TYPE OF EQUIPMENT WITHOUT A HOOD SYSTEM.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS WITH VARIOUS COOKING UTENSILS IN THEIR BASINS AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC REMOVED UTENSILS FROM SINKS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS ARE FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.
